name: gradient-mean-fruit
blurb: Peach to purple gradient at 120 degrees.
description: A linear gradient from warm peach (#fccb90) to cool purple (#d57eeb) across 120 degrees. Renders as a div with the gradient applied as background.
use_when: Section or card backgrounds that need a warm-to-cool decorative gradient.
avoid_when: Content areas requiring high contrast or exact brand colors — these are fixed hardcoded hues.
a11y: Wrapper only; applies a decorative background gradient with no interactive elements.
